_about: Attack Animation puzzles. Each puzzle = one class + its clips: videos/anim/video<N>.webm/.mp4/.jpg (numbers just count up, so file names give nothing away; a class can have several puzzles). videos: clip 1 [, clip 2]. credit / creditImage: who recorded it, shown on the win screen. skills: the skill shown in each clip, listed on the win screen. since (YYYY-MM-DD): first day it can be the answer. days: fixed puzzle ids for puzzles #1, #2, ...; after them a shuffled cycle over every puzzle. Add clips with tools/add_clip.py.
